page_title: WHU 2-3 AST | West Ham v Aston Villa 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mateus Fernandes (West Ham).
90+2' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+1' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lucas Paqueta.
89' Here's the change. Crysencio Summerville leaves the pitch and Mohamadou Kante (West Ham) comes on as a substitute.
88' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to make a change. Tomas Soucek (West Ham) replaces Freddie Potts.

86' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alphonse Areola makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
82' Aston Villa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
81' Substitution. Soungoutou Magassa makes way for Callum Wilson (West Ham).
79' 2 - 3 Goal! Victor Lindelof plays a long ball to Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the top left corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 2:3.
78' Chance! Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
77' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) brings an opponent down and Anthony Taylor interrupts the game.
75' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Ian Maatsen will be replaced by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
75' Substitution. Ollie Watkins did his best and is replaced by Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa).
73' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
71' 15:9 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
70' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and signals a foul after Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) brought his opponent down.
69' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
67' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.

67' West Ham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

65' Alphonse Areola makes a brilliant save! Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
64' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) replacing Amadou Onana.
62' West Ham fail to score from a corner as Marco Bizot (Aston Villa) leaps to collect the ball.
61' Freddie Potts (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
61' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
60' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
60' West Ham are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
59' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham).
58' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
56' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
56' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
55' A corner kick by West Ham is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Bizot (Aston Villa).

55' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, West Ham are going to take it.
50' 2 - 2 Goal Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa)! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) was put through by Youri Tielemans and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
49' It looks like Freddie Potts (West Ham) saw red with that tackle. Anthony Taylor won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
47' Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
42' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
39' The resulting free kick from Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
36' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
32' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
30' Neat passing move from Aston Villa in order to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Anthony Taylor sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
26' The West Ham players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
24' 2 - 1 Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
23' Aston Villa fail to score from a corner as Alphonse Areola (West Ham) leaps to collect the ball.
22' The corner from Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is intercepted by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.
21' An attempted cross from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is cleared.
19' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
14' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

9' 1 - 1 Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it under the roof of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
6' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) tries to find Morgan Rogers, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
6' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
5' Aston Villa hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' 1 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Mateus Fernandes (West Ham), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:0.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
West Ham will kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will supervise the game today.
